test_title: PYST 07: SSC JE EE - General Intelligence (Held on 05 Jun 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means 'A is the mother of B',

'A - B' means 'A is the brother of B',

'A × B' means 'A is the wife of B', and

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the father of B'.

How is T related to O if 'P + N - S ÷ O + M × T'?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 
 

 

Given: P + N - S ÷ O + M × T

It means:

 
• P + N: P is the mother of N
 
• N - S: N is the brother of S
 
• S ÷ O: S is the father of O
 
• O + M: O is the mother of M
 
• M × T: M is the wife of T

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fccb39ed90425dd3217ffbe8ebfb061ae16ae7dc0d77e446d3d2284851da6add.png] 

So, T is the **Daughter's husband** of O.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
